The fix is a verification-bug repair with a test, but it changes pik_printed output for every fund, so it needs a cohort ledger re-run like D-235. AMENDED: After independent review rfbnc: the request overclaimed (it said all 10 converted rows have par-growth evidence; the Cube USD delayed draw 2025-09-30 has none and its D-232 conversion was undone in rfbne). A repair that only widens the printed-format match would silently clear contradicted rows, so any repair must also require independent whole-coupon evidence (par growth) and must not clear a row whose own line or tag contradicts whole-coupon PIK. Still deferred to the end-of-run shared-code batch.
statement: pik_printed (pik_printed_not_published): the D-232 whole-coupon test (_PIK_AFTER_BENCHMARK) needs '<benchmark> [(tenor)] +' before 'm % PIK'. This filer prints the benchmark in its own Index cell with no plus ('SONIA | 10.00% PIK | 14.22 | %', 'EURIBOR | 10.00% PIK | 13.25 | %'), so a whole-coupon PIK row published with pik_rate = the coupon raises pik_value_mismatch (7 findings, 10 rows).
